description: Meeting detail projection: the detail fields built from a meeting for a viewer.

cases.inputs: meeting: Draft, AssignedApproverId set; actorId: creator.
preconditions: Draft meeting with a stale AssignedApproverId.
cases.return: Details with AssignedApproverId null (hidden before submission).

preconditions: Published meeting with a Chair, two Secretaries named "Bình" and "An", and the actor is a Member who has not answered.
cases.return: Chair set; Secretaries ordered by name (An, Bình); MyMeetingRole "Member"; MyResponse null; CanRespond true.

cases.inputs: meeting: Cancelled; CancelledAt set; CancelledBy "Lan"; reason "Hoãn".
preconditions: Meeting is Cancelled with a stored cancellation time and canceller.

cases.inputs: two Chair rows, one not Current.
preconditions: Meeting has an inactive Chair row (replaced) next to the current Chair.
cases.return: Chair is the current one only.
